m.d: A system is a group of things that work together; a way of doing something.
m.e: This coloured paper is part of my system for keeping lists of people.

m.d: If A syncs with B, A synchronizes with B, usually used for data, time, or music synchronization.
A symbol is a letter or simple picture with a particular meaning.
m.e: Most language now use the same set of symbols to represent numbers.

m.d: A symbol is a person or object that represents a group or idea.
m.e: These dead trees have become a symbol of pollution.

m.d: Sydney is the largest city in Australia and the capital of New South Wales.
Sydney is a unisex given name.
A feeling of pity or sorrow for another person.
Being able to understand and share the feelings of another person.
An understanding between people who are both affected by the same things.
A syndrome is multiple symptoms combined together characterizing a disease or mental problem.
Syrup is a thick, sticky, sweet liquid made from sugar, water and flavourings.
m.e: I poured syrup on my waffles and pancakes.

m.d: If you are sympathetic, you care about somebody else's problems.
If you are sympathetic towards a plan or idea, you support it.
A symphony is music that is written for an orchestra.
m.e: Beethoven's most famous symphony was Symphony No. 5.

m.d: Syria is a country in Asia, the capital city is Damascus.
If something is symbolic, it has or is used as a symbol.
m.e: In many religions, the number 3 has a symbolic value.

m.d: A syndicate is a group of people or companies that work together for a specific business or interest.
If you syndicate, you become a syndicate.
When something is synthetic, it is artificial, fake, man-made or not genuine.
A symptom is a sign or indication of something, usually an illness.
m.e: He began to show symptoms of chicken pox a few days ago.

m.d: If you sympathize a person, you show or express sympathy towards them as their feelings are affected by something.
A place of worship for Jews.
If something is done systematically, it is done in a systematic manner.
A balance or harmony of parts.
A division of the body would produce two parts which are mirror images of each other.
An arrangement of parts around a central point.
m.e: An orange has symmetry: it is a sphere with segments arranged around a common central line.

m.d: If something is done in a systematic way, it is done according to a plan or procedure.
Symmetrical means having the property of symmetry.
A syllable is a word or part of a word that has one vowel sound in it. The vowel might have consonants around it or be by itself.
m.e: The word "potato" has three syllables, "po," "ta," and "to."

m.d: If an item symbolizes a meaning, it represents it as a symbol.
If you synchronize two or more clocks, watches, etc., you set them to show the same time.
m.e: They synchronized their watches and agreed to meet at four o'clock.

m.d: If you synchronize two or more things, you make them happen at the same time or go at the same pace.
m.e: The bus arrivals were now synchronized with the subway times.
